runtimeMapping.normalFire: Single-target ground/air physical homing projectile; original attack events and source speed 10.
runtimeMapping.shield: Adjacent cardinal ground tile, zero slots, 5 DP, two blocks, taunt, heal-free, source elite lifetime, finish-started 30-second recharge.
runtimeMapping.direction: Body/range rotates immediately; original facing waits in local 0.1-second intervals while incapacitated or blocking; removal restores saved direction.
runtimeMapping.talents: Shield-dependent owner/rear DEF and selected-potential E2 damage-to-SP probability; ordinary active-skill SP locks apply.
runtimeMapping.S1: Permanent ATK/DEF, matching shield DEF and once-per-shield lifetime extension.
runtimeMapping.S2: Finite ATK/BAT/dodge/range modifiers; original Begin/Loop/End clips.
runtimeMapping.S3: Twenty rounds, separate owner/token DEF, ATK/BAT/range modifiers; shell competes with ordinary fire without consuming ammunition.
runtimeMapping.shell: Original release event, source speed/collider/radius/ATK/stun; first swept collision or terminal arrival detonates once; emitted shots survive cancellation.

verificationLimits: Original C# controller execution, event dispatch ordering and game-frame parity are not recovered from serialized components.
Closed tile filter 12 is mapped to the furthest on-map forward tile in the active range. Continuous swept collision replaces native 0.03-second polling.
Local clocks implement body/face waits, composite shell interruption and event-4 ammo release plus final animation tail; native frame ordering is not certified.
Shield SP uses positive post-mitigation damage hooks; native ON_TAKE_DAMAGE dispatch order is not certified. Shell damage reads current owner ATK at impact.
Modules, original particles and audio are not implemented.
